title: The reader's two mounts share one call and one room connection, so Join call opens the call window

tasks.title: One host per page for the call, room, recording, broadcast and replay controllers

acs.text: WHEN the reader mounts the page and the persistent mount with different host objects THE SYSTEM SHALL use one call controller, one room controller, one room-sessions registry, one recording, broadcast and replay controller and one window owner for the page, so that Join call pressed in the page mount opens the pre-join step in the persistent mount's call window
scenarios: AC-001 Join call in the lobby opens the call window

acs.text: WHILE both mounts show the same room THE SYSTEM SHALL hold one connection to it, so the viewer appears once in who is here
WHEN a host was never registered by the entry (one host for both mounts, as in the harness and the tests) THE SYSTEM SHALL behave as before
scenarios: AC-003 one host for both mounts
